test_groupby_first: test the groupby first method returns the first row per group from a DataFrame
test_groupby_last: test the groupby last method returns the last row per group from a DataFrame
test_groupby_nth_index: test the groupby nth method retrieves the nth row per group by integer index
test_groupby_nth_multiple: test the groupby nth method with a list of indices returns multiple rows per group
test_groupby_nth_dropna: test the groupby nth method with dropna parameter filters rows containing NaN values
